english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that you find where something is.
This is the all-purpose choice when you find something by looking or searching for it.
Use this when spot means find or locate something rather than merely see it.
Use this everyday verb when someone successfully gets or secures something such as a job.
Use 搵到 when people or things have been located or found, as in all passengers being accounted for.

examples.english: I finally managed to locate the restaurant.
